# External Dependencies

Third-party packages that are vendored (included directly) rather than installed from PyPI.

## webshop-minimal

Lightweight WebShop simulator for the WebShop environment. Provides a local search engine and product database for training web shopping agents.

**Source**: [github.com/ZihanWang314/webshop-minimal](https://github.com/ZihanWang314/webshop-minimal)

**Install**:
```bash
cd external/webshop-minimal
pip install -e .
```

**Note**: This is automatically installed by `scripts/setup_ufb.sh`.
